items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: he don't play them no more because, uh, some of the fellas, they don't know him... he knew it and I probably knew it

ctx.x: Some of y'all don't play anymore, like, uh, Monk used to play, Yes Lord, I'm Crippled, and sometimes my burden is hard to bear. I don't know if you'd play them.

No, he don't play them no more because, uh, some of the fellas, they don't know him, you know? Uh-huh. A lot of times people come to the unexpected and action for those numbers and, well, he knew it and I probably knew it and Howard might know it and what the balance of the other fellas don't know it. So we just let him go.
